messages.content: Hello, Mr. Zhang. I am so sorry to disturb you at this time.
Oh, don't worry. It's okay. I'm just having a bit of rest, but I can understand.
My husband and I are painting the living room walls this weekend. It will be very noisy.
Ah, I see. Painting is a lot of work. But be careful not to make too much dust inside.
We are also moving all the heavy furniture to the other side of the room.
That sounds tiring. You must need strong workers to lift the big sofa alone.
By the way, I saw a video on YouTube about how Americans love big burgers and fries.
Oh, food is always interesting. You know, we have delicious dumplings here in Xi'an instead.
Yes, I think the taste is quite different from what I used to eat.
I agree. But actually, our local spicy noodles are very famous in this whole city.
Maybe I will try them next week after the renovation is finished.
That's a good plan. I will make a pot for you when you come back to visit me.
That would be very kind of you. Thank you so much, Mr. Zhang.
Of course. Please just call me old Zhang. You can come by anytime for tea.
I will definitely come later. I hope the noise does not bother you too much.
It is fine. I am happy to hear you are making your home more beautiful.

messages.content: Hi Uncle Wang. I am Zhang Ya. My parents and I are free this weekend.
Hello Ya! I'm happy to hear that. We are going to visit my grandmother in Suzhou. It is a nice trip.
That sounds great. Do we need to buy train tickets now or wait?
Well, you should book them soon. Tickets are hard to find now. By the way, how much is a round-trip ticket?
About three hundred yuan. I think we will go by high-speed train.
Yes, high-speed trains are very fast and comfortable. Oh, I saw a new American movie about superheroes last night. It was very exciting!
Oh, really? I did not see it. What is the name of the movie?
I think it is called 'Guardians of the Galaxy'. Well, I am not sure if you like action movies. Anyway, are you going to watch table tennis on TV?
No, I prefer watching basketball. My brother plays very well.
That is good! Basketball is fun to watch. My cousin Li plays badminton very well. He wins many games. We play together every weekend.
That is nice. What do you usually eat for lunch with your family?
We usually eat dumplings and hot and sour soup. It tastes very good. Do you like dumplings? You can make them at home too.
Yes, I love dumplings. I will make them for my parents this weekend.
That is a wonderful idea! Your parents will be very happy. You know, we also need to buy some fresh vegetables at the market.
Okay. Where is the best market near your home, Uncle Wang?
There is a good market near Xingfu Street. The prices are low there. We can go together if you want. What do you think?

messages.content: Hi Uncle Li. I am planning a trip to Hangzhou this weekend. We are going to visit my grandparents there.
That sounds wonderful, Ya. Hangzhou is very beautiful. I hope you have a great time with your family.
Yes, we love it there. By the way, the new law about taxes is good for the economy now.
Oh, that is interesting. Well, I think we should focus on our trip today. How much will it cost to buy train tickets?
I am not sure yet. Maybe it is around three hundred yuan. I will check the price later.
That is a reasonable price. I will go to the supermarket to buy some food. Do you want to buy snacks too?
Yes, please. I want to eat some local food like bing tang yulu.
Great idea! Bing tang yulu is sweet and cold. It is perfect for a hot day. We can buy some now.
Okay. What time is the train leaving? I will go to the station at two o'clock.
The train leaves at four o'clock. We have enough time to eat lunch first. What would you like to eat?
I think we can have some fried rice and hot tea. It is very cheap and tasty.
That sounds like a perfect meal. I will order some dumplings too. They are my favourite food.

messages.content: Hello, I am Liu Fang. I have a bad cough today.
Oh dear, I'm sorry to hear that. When did you start coughing, Liu Fang?
It started yesterday morning. The air in Kunming was very cold.
I see. December weather can be very chilly here. Have you tried drinking some herbal tea?
Yes, I drank some chrysanthemum tea. It helped a little bit.
Well, that is a good choice for colds. By the way, do you have friends you meet with for drinks?
Sometimes we drink together on weekends. It makes me feel happy.
I understand you feel happy, but let's focus on your health now. You should rest more today.
Okay, I will rest. Do I need to take medicine?
Yes, I think you should take some syrup. It will help you feel better soon.
Thank you, doctor. I will go home and drink the tea.
That is a good plan. I hope you feel better tomorrow. Goodbye, Liu Fang.

messages.content: Hello doctor. I'm Liu Fang. I have a bad cough today.
Hello, Liu Fang. I'm Nurse Zhang. Oh, really? When did the cough start?
It started yesterday. I'm feeling very tired now.
I see. Kunming weather is chilly in December, isn't it? It's hard to breathe.
Yes. Also, I read about a long time ago when the old leaders fought for power in history books.
Well, that's interesting history. By the way, have you tried drinking hot herbal tea at home?
No, I haven't. What kind of tea is good for a cough?
You should try lian qiao tea. It's very good for sore throats and coughs.
Okay. Do I need to take medicine as well?
Yes. I'll give you some medicine. You must take it three times a day.
Thank you. I will drink the tea and take the pills.
That's a good plan. I hope you feel better soon, Liu Fang. Good luck!

messages.content: Hi Sun Yue! It is New Year's Eve in Harbin. I am cooking dumplings for my family.
Oh, that is so nice! I love dumplings. Are you making the sweet and sour kind?
Yes, we like sweet and sour sauce. I will add some vinegar later.
Good idea! By the way, I am going to eat some sweet potato tea after dinner.
Oh, sweet potato tea is delicious. I have eaten it before. Actually, I think American fast food is very popular now.
Well, I see you like fast food. However, I think we should focus on our own tea today. It is very warm for January.
Yes, the cold weather makes me want hot drinks. What time will you arrive?
I will arrive at seven o'clock. I am bringing some nian gao for dessert.
Nian gao sounds tasty. Will you bring it in a bag?
Of course! I will put it in a red paper bag. It is a special tradition.
That is a good idea. Do you play badminton on weekends?
Yes, I play badminton every Saturday. It is good exercise for the winter.
I should try that. I am going to the park with my son next weekend.
That sounds fun! You can bring your son to Harbin Central Park. It is very big.
